millager.config.title: Millager Configuration
millager.config.overview.game_rule_defau: These settings provide the default values of the mod's game rules for newly created worlds. They do not change existing worlds, which continue to use their own /gamerule values.
millager.config.overview.defender: These settings cover raid reinforcements and raider empowerment. When raid reinforcements are enabled, millagers arrive in batches during raids. Each countdown starts with the base value, subtracts the number of valid beds multiplied by the per-bed weight, then adds the previous squads' total health. Results below the minimum use the minimum, and results above the maximum use the maximum. The countdown then decreases every game tick by the amount set for the current difficulty. The number of reinforcement squads in each deployment varies above or below a base of one more squad than the previous raid wave deployed. Clearing a raider wave within the configured time empowers the next wave, while the final raider wave is always empowered. Empowerment adds raiders and is limited by difficulty. The time limit is based on the raider count multiplied by the configured time weights. By default, the first four raiders add 12 seconds each, the next four add 7 seconds each, and every remaining raider adds 4 seconds. Raiders added by empowerment also count toward the limit after applying the multiplier for the current difficulty. Changes take effect with the next countdown.
millager.config.overview.patrol: These settings cover wild patrols and command-post patrols. Both spawn only in the Overworld and require mob spawning to be enabled. Wild patrols also require the Wild Patrols game rule. Each wild-patrol wait is the base interval plus a random number of game ticks no greater than the configured random-interval limit. When the timer ends, the game first uses the spawn chance to decide whether to attempt a patrol, then uses the cavalry chance to choose its type. The spawn position must also meet the configured requirements for days played, distance from the player, distance from villages, loaded chunks and the nearby millager limit. If any check fails, no patrol spawns during that cycle and the timer still resets. For command-post patrols, the game scans around players for newly discovered command posts or ruined command posts, then spawns a patrol after the configured delay. Normal command posts are also subject to the structure patrol unit limit. Timer settings take effect on the next reset; other settings take effect on the next check or spawn.
millager.config.overview.misc: These settings cover structure generation and other miscellaneous options. Each structure type can be controlled separately. Standalone structure toggles immediately prevent the corresponding structures from generating in new chunks, while the village infantry hut toggle takes effect the next time the world or server starts. Existing structures are not removed. A ridden horse receives the fast cleanup tag when its rider dies, while an unridden horse is removed after a delay. Horse cleanup times and the doctor iron golem build limit affect subsequent behavior immediately.
millager.config.option.game_rule_default: Controls whether newly created worlds use millager reinforcements during raids. Enabled by default; use /gamerule to change this in an existing world.
Controls whether reinforcement millagers retreat and disappear after a raid in newly created worlds. Enabled by default; use /gamerule to change this in an existing world.
Controls whether friendly fire is enabled for the millager faction in newly created worlds. Disabled by default; use /gamerule to change this in an existing world.
Controls whether wild millager patrols spawn in newly created worlds; this does not affect command-post patrols. Disabled by default; use /gamerule to change this in an existing world.
millager.config.option.defender.team_nam: The scoreboard team name used by reinforcement millagers during raids. The default is millager_defense; enter 1-16 characters using A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _, ., + or -.
millager.config.option.defender.tick_dec: Sets how much reinforcement countdown is removed per tick on Easy. Higher values make reinforcements arrive sooner. The value is an integer countdown amount per game tick. The default is 4, and the range is 1-100.

Sets how much reinforcement countdown is removed per tick on Normal. Higher values make reinforcements arrive sooner. The value is an integer countdown amount per game tick. The default is 2, and the range is 1-100.

Sets how much reinforcement countdown is removed per tick on Hard. Higher values make reinforcements arrive sooner. The value is an integer countdown amount per game tick. The default is 1, and the range is 1-100.
millager.config.option.defender.timer_ba: Sets the base used to calculate each reinforcement countdown. Higher values usually delay reinforcements. The value is an integer countdown amount. The default is 2100, and the range is 1-72000.
millager.config.option.defender.timer_pe: Sets the amount subtracted from the countdown for each valid bed. Higher values make beds shorten the wait more strongly. The value is an integer countdown amount per valid bed. The default is 175, and the range is 0-72000.
millager.config.option.defender.timer_re: Sets the minimum calculated reinforcement countdown. Higher values increase the shortest possible wait. The value is an integer countdown amount. The default is 1400, and the range is 1-72000.

Sets the maximum calculated reinforcement countdown. Higher values increase the longest possible wait. The value is an integer countdown amount. The default is 6300; the value cannot be lower than the minimum countdown or higher than 72000.
millager.config.option.defender.deployed: Sets how long the squad-arrival message remains visible. Higher values keep the message visible longer, while 0 removes the hold time. Time is measured in game ticks. The default is 100, and the range is 0-12000.
millager.config.option.defender.bed_cach: Sets the interval between recounts of valid village beds. Higher values delay bed changes taking effect but reduce recount frequency. Time is measured in game ticks. The default is 1200, and the range is 1-72000.
millager.config.option.defender.max_heig: Sets the maximum vertical difference between a reinforcement spawn and the raid center. Higher values accept a wider height difference. Distance is measured in blocks. The default is 48, and the range is 0-384.
millager.config.option.defender.spawn_se: Sets the maximum number of positions checked for each reinforcement spawn. Higher values improve the chance of finding a valid position but perform more checks. The default is 20, and the range is 1-1000.
millager.config.option.defender.squad_mi: Sets the minimum members in each reinforcement squad. Higher values increase the smallest possible squad. The default is 3, and the range is 1-100.
millager.config.option.defender.squad_ma: Sets the maximum members in each reinforcement squad. Higher values allow larger squads. The default is 5; the value cannot be lower than the minimum squad size or higher than 100.
millager.config.option.defender.squad_co: Sets how far the actual squad count may vary above or below its base. Higher values increase variation between reinforcement waves. The default is 1, and the range is 0-100.
millager.config.option.defender.max_squa: Sets the maximum reinforcement squads deployed in one wave. Higher values allow more squads to arrive in a wave. The default is 4, and the range is 1-32.
millager.config.option.defender.squad_sp: Sets the minimum horizontal distance from a squad spawn center to the raid center. Higher values keep reinforcements from spawning too close. Distance is measured in blocks. The default is 36, and the range is 0-512.

Sets the maximum horizontal distance from a squad spawn center to the raid center. Higher values allow reinforcements to spawn farther away. Distance is measured in blocks. The default is 52; the value cannot be lower than the minimum spawn distance or higher than 512.
millager.config.option.defender.squad_me: Sets the horizontal spread of members around their squad spawn center. Higher values spread squad members farther apart. Distance is measured in blocks. The default is 4, and the range is 0-32.
millager.config.option.defender.cavalry_: Sets the extra horizontal collision clearance required for mounted reinforcements. Higher values require more open space and may reduce successful cavalry spawns. Distance is measured in blocks. The default is 1.0, and the range is 0.0-16.0.
millager.config.option.defender.fast_cle: Sets how many raiders use the first timing tier. Higher values apply the first-tier seconds to more raiders when calculating the empowerment threshold. The default is 4, and the range is 1-100.
Sets how many raiders after the first tier use the second timing tier. Higher values apply the second-tier seconds to more raiders. The default is 4, and the range is 1-100.
Sets the clear-time allowance added by each first-tier raider. Higher values make fast-clear empowerment easier to trigger. The default is 12, and the range is 0-3600.
Sets the clear-time allowance added by each second-tier raider. Higher values make fast-clear empowerment easier to trigger. The default is 7, and the range is 0-3600.
Sets the clear-time allowance added by each raider beyond the first two tiers. Higher values give large raid waves more time to qualify for empowerment. The default is 4, and the range is 0-3600.
millager.config.option.defender.empowere: Sets how strongly extra raiders on Easy count toward the next clear-time threshold. Higher values count extra raiders more heavily and make later empowerment easier. The value is a multiplier. The default is 0.5, and the range is 0.0-10.0.

Sets how strongly extra raiders on Normal count toward the next clear-time threshold. Higher values count extra raiders more heavily and make later empowerment easier. The value is a multiplier. The default is 0.4, and the range is 0.0-10.0.

Sets how strongly extra raiders on Hard count toward the next clear-time threshold. Higher values count extra raiders more heavily and make later empowerment easier. The value is a multiplier. The default is 0.2, and the range is 0.0-10.0.
millager.config.option.defender.max_cons: Sets how many consecutive attempts that fail to spawn any reinforcement squads are allowed before further reinforcements stop for the current raid. Successfully spawning at least one squad resets the failure count. Higher values allow more spawn failures. The default is 3, and the range is 1-100.
millager.config.option.defender.spawn_fa: Sets the number of game ticks before retrying after an attempt spawns no reinforcement squads. Higher values delay the retry. The default is 20, and the range is 0-72000.
millager.config.option.patrol.wild_timer: Sets the base interval between wild-patrol spawn attempts. Higher values make attempts less frequent. Time is measured in game ticks. The default is 18000, and the range is 1-720000.

Sets the upper bound of the random delay added to the wild-patrol interval. Higher values add more timing variation, while 0 adds no random delay. Time is measured in game ticks. The default is 1200, and the range is 0-720000.
millager.config.option.patrol.wild_patro: Sets the chance of making a spawn attempt when the wild-patrol timer ends. Higher values make spawn attempts more likely. Use a decimal probability. The default is 0.25, and the range is 0.0-1.0.
millager.config.option.patrol.wild_caval: Sets the chance that a wild patrol uses cavalry instead of infantry. Higher values produce cavalry patrols more often. Use a decimal probability. The default is 0.5, and the range is 0.0-1.0.
millager.config.option.patrol.max_nearby: Sets the nearby millager limit for a wild-patrol spawn center. Higher values allow more nearby millagers before patrol spawning is blocked. The default is 16, and the range is 1-1000.
millager.config.option.patrol.millager_c: Sets the radius used to count millagers near a wild-patrol spawn center. Higher values count a wider area and make the nearby limit easier to reach. Distance is measured in blocks. The default is 48, and the range is 1-512.
millager.config.option.patrol.infantry_m: Sets the minimum members in a wild infantry patrol. Higher values increase the smallest possible infantry patrol. The default is 5, and the range is 1-100.
Sets the maximum members in a wild infantry patrol. Higher values allow larger infantry patrols. The default is 8; the value cannot be lower than the infantry minimum or higher than 100.
millager.config.option.patrol.cavalry_mi: Sets the minimum members in a wild cavalry patrol. Higher values increase the smallest possible cavalry patrol. The default is 4, and the range is 1-100.
millager.config.option.patrol.cavalry_ma: Sets the maximum members in a wild cavalry patrol. Higher values allow larger cavalry patrols. The default is 7; the value cannot be lower than the cavalry minimum or higher than 100.
millager.config.option.patrol.spawn_min_: Sets the minimum horizontal distance between a wild patrol and the player. Higher values keep patrols from spawning too close to the player. Distance is measured in blocks. The default is 24, and the range is 0-512.
millager.config.option.patrol.spawn_max_: Sets the maximum horizontal distance between a wild patrol and the player. Higher values allow patrols to spawn farther away. Distance is measured in blocks. The default is 48; the value cannot be lower than the minimum spawn distance or higher than 512.
millager.config.option.patrol.min_days_p: Sets how long a world must exist before wild patrols may spawn. Higher values delay the first eligible day. Time is measured in in-game days. The default is 3, and the range is 0-100000.
millager.config.option.patrol.command_po: Sets the interval between scans for command-post structures near players. Higher values discover structures more slowly but reduce scan frequency and cost. Time is measured in game ticks. The default is 100, and the range is 1-72000.
millager.config.option.patrol.structure_: Sets the wait after first finding a command-post structure before its patrol spawns. Higher values delay the structure patrol. Time is measured in game ticks. The default is 20, and the range is 0-72000.
millager.config.option.patrol.command_po: Sets the structure search radius around the current chunk of each player. Higher values cover more chunks and increase scan cost. Distance is measured in chunks. The default is 6, and the range is 0-64.
millager.config.option.patrol.structure_: Sets the patrol-unit limit near a structure. Higher values allow more patrol units near the structure. The default is 10, and the range is 1-1000.

Sets the radius used to count patrol units near a structure. Higher values count a wider area and make the structure limit easier to reach. Distance is measured in blocks. The default is 64, and the range is 1-512.
millager.config.option.patrol.command_po: Sets the planned members in each normal command-post patrol. Higher values create larger squads, subject to the structure patrol limit. The default is 3, and the range is 1-100.

Sets the maximum horizontal coordinate offset of the first normal patrol spawn from the command-post center. Higher values may place the first spawn farther from the command-post center. Distance is measured in blocks. The default is 24, and the range is 0-512.
millager.config.option.patrol.ruined_cp_: Sets the minimum members in a ruined-command-post illager patrol. Higher values increase the smallest possible patrol. The default is 5, and the range is 1-100.
Sets the maximum members in a ruined-command-post illager patrol. Higher values allow larger patrols. The default is 7; the value cannot be lower than the ruined-post minimum or higher than 100.

Sets the maximum horizontal coordinate offset of the first patrol spawn from the ruined-command-post center. Higher values may place the first spawn farther from the ruined-command-post center. Distance is measured in blocks. The default is 24, and the range is 0-512.
millager.config.option.misc.generate_com: Controls whether command posts generate in new chunks. It is enabled by default. Disabling it does not remove existing command posts.
millager.config.option.misc.generate_rui: Controls whether ruined command posts generate in new chunks. It is enabled by default. Disabling it does not remove existing ruined command posts.
millager.config.option.misc.generate_flo: Controls whether floating islands generate in new chunks. It is enabled by default. Disabling it does not remove existing floating islands.
millager.config.option.misc.generate_str: Controls whether strong rooms generate in new chunks. It is enabled by default. Disabling it does not remove existing strong rooms.
millager.config.option.misc.generate_tra: Controls whether trading halls generate in new chunks. It is enabled by default. Disabling it does not remove existing trading halls.
millager.config.option.misc.generate_inf: Controls whether infantry huts are added to village building pools. It is enabled by default. Changes require restarting the world or server, and disabling it does not remove existing huts.
millager.config.option.misc.fast_horse_d: Sets how many game ticks a millager horse marked for fast cleanup remains without a living passenger before disappearing. Higher values keep the horse longer. The default is 140, and the range is 0-72000.
millager.config.option.misc.mount_horse_: Sets how many game ticks a normal millager mount remains without a living passenger before disappearing. Higher values keep unridden mounts longer. The default is 900, and the range is 0-72000.
millager.config.option.misc.doctor_iron_: Sets the total number of iron golems each doctor can build. A doctor stops building after reaching the limit; -1 removes the total limit. The default is 3, and the range is -1-1000.
